# Refund Policy

Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
Opened items are accepted within 14 days and carry a 15% restocking fee.

Refunds reach the original payment method 5 working days after the parcel
arrives at our Manchester depot. Gift cards are never refundable.

To start a return, email returns@example.com quoting the order number and we
post a prepaid label the same working day.
